column1: # The community patch repo's libpnsovr.so edits, one row per edited instruction, mapped to what our build does at
# the same place (#944). The patch repo is EchoTools/echoApkPatch at 310069eb: its 8 entitlement patches
# (configs/libpnsovr.so.yaml) and its 70-site license overlay (patcher/license_patch.yaml), plus the second of the two
# per-player id slots that overlay's header names (license_patch.yaml:12-13; the first is the 0x2ecf0c row). Nothing
# here takes their bytes: `change` says in words what their edit does, and every other column is measured on the pinned
#   source      the patch repo's file:line for the row
#   their_va    their address (the disassembly's: the pinned vaddr + 0x100000)
#   vaddr       ours, the link-time address in the pinned library (their_va - 0x100000)
#   stock       the instruction word the pinned library holds there
#   function    the exported function that holds it (or <import>@plt for a PLT stub)
#   change      what their edit does, in words
#   covered_by  the hook in this tree that covers the site, as <path>:<symbol> (comma-separated), or -
#   reason      why the hook covers it, or, with no hook, why none is needed
# tools/quest_patcher_sites.py checks the table (`just test-tools`: every row has a hook or a reason, every hook named
# exists) and, with the extracted library, every stock word and function (`just test-quest-hooks-pinned`).

column6: bl ovr_GetLoggedInUserID -> mov w0,<the player's Oculus id> (per player)
column8: The call stays: a nonzero app-scoped id is the SDK's and a zero one is stood in by the hook; the identity the server sees is the NEVR account from token auth, set by the login rewrite (login_rewrite.h), and the send gate refuses a login whose accountid is still the stand-in, so every player runs the same signed APK
